item.name: README - How to Use This Collection

request.description:
1. First login with your existing auth API as admin/superadmin and paste token in collection variable adminToken.
2. Login as normal user and paste token in userToken.
3. Copy normal user's id into userId.
4. Make sure backend is running.
5. Run seed first from terminal:
   node scripts/seedTokingGoldConfig.js
6. Run requests in order from Phase 1 to Phase 5.
7. After minting NFT, copy returned data._id into collection variable nftId manually unless test script captures it.
8. For mining, NFT must be STAKED.
9. Note: this collection uses the live mounted ledger route `/api/ledger` for ledger details requests.
